20. Performance test types

Load tests expected demand; stress tests beyond capacity; soak tests sustained demand; spike
tests sudden bursts.
Load testing සාමාන්‍ය traffic එක බලනවා. Stress එක සීමාව ඉක්මවලා බලනවා. Soak එක දිගු

Q: What is p95 latency?
